name: Full-face diving mask
description: A clear domed visor in a rubber skirt that seals over the whole face, eyes, nose and mouth together, held on by a four-strap harness. The breathing port at the mouth is empty: no regulator is fitted.
notes: Standing on its chin, front on +z, 176 mm across, 188 mm tall and 184 mm deep with the harness: a domed `plastic-clear` visor in a yellow frame and a black rubber skirt, an empty black port at the mouth and two strap loops joined by a back pad. CHECK VOLUME (x4.1): the harness loops stand open behind the mask, spanning air the reference folds away. The reference is the not-ready state; fitting a regulator to make it breathe underwater needs Deadvox item states and a drowning system, both pending. Slot `face`, as earlier masks have it; it covers the eyes too, so it should block `eyes`. Tiles draw the visor opaque; it stays see-through in the game. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Swimsuit
description: A one-piece stretch swimsuit cut high at the legs, with thin shoulder straps and a scooped neck. Dries fast and keeps nothing warm.
notes: Laid flat, front up, straps at +z, 500 mm from crotch to shoulders and 300 mm across: red body printed with a flag (white stripes and a navy canton of white stars), black trim round the leg openings and under the bust, a darker scoop at the neckline and the two shoulder straps folded down flat over the front. Slot `torso`, as whole-body suits take; it covers the legs too, so it should block `briefs` and `bra` (batch 175's slots for swim briefs and bikini tops). The reference gives no warmth. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Swim goggles
description: Two small tinted eyecups on a short nose bridge and a silicone strap, made to keep water out of the eyes while swimming.
notes: Standing on their cups, front on +z, 112 mm across and 66 mm deep with the strap looped behind: tinted lenses in clear blue cups with black gaskets, a black bridge and a blue strap, built on `g.eyewear` goggles. Slot `eyes`, as Deadvox's night-vision goggles have it. Seeing clearly underwater needs a swimming system Deadvox does not have yet. Tiles draw the lenses opaque; they stay see-through in the game. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Rash vest
description: A long-sleeved, close-fitting stretch shirt worn for swimming and surfing, to save the skin from sunburn and from rubbing against boards and suits.
notes: Folded on a shelf, neck at +z, 300 mm square and 52 mm tall: black body with blue sleeves folded along the sides, a blue stand collar and a blue chest panel, on `g.jacket` with no front opening. Slot `torso`, as shirts have it. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Shark suit
description: A one-piece suit of fine steel mail from hood to toes, mitts and socks included, made for divers working among sharks. It turns teeth and blades, but a hard blow still lands.
notes: Laid out flat, front up, hood at -z, 1836 mm from hood to toes and 1032 mm across the arms: `steel-mail` hood, body, arms ending in mitts and legs ending in socks, ringed with darker raised rows of links, a black face opening and collar. CHECK VOLUME (x6.5): the reference gives the suit bundled up; laid out flat its box is far emptier. Slot `vest`, as all body armour takes; it covers the head, arms and legs too, so it should block `torso` and `legs`. Protection is a judgement for fine mild-steel mail: good against cuts, weaker against points and blows. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Bonded shark suit
description: A one-piece mail diving suit whose every part has been bonded together with copper braid and fitted with a grounding lead. Current that strikes it runs round the wearer instead of through them.
notes: Its own model: the shark suit laid out flat, with copper bonding braids down each arm and leg and across the chest and waist, and a copper grounding lead ending in a steel clip at the right hip. CHECK VOLUME (x9.7): the reference gives the suit bundled up; laid out flat, with the lead trailing, its box is far emptier. Slot `vest`, as all body armour takes; it covers the head, arms and legs too, so it should block `torso` and `legs`. Deadvox has no electric damage kind, so the shielding goes unmodelled, as batch 173 notes for its Faraday mail suit. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Racing briefs
description: Very short, tight black swimming briefs with a drawcord at the waist, cut for racing in the pool.
notes: Laid flat, front up, waist at +z, 304 mm across the waist and 152 mm deep: black body and waistband with a white drawcord tied at the front. Slot `briefs`, batch 175's slot for swimwear worn under trousers. The reference gives no warmth. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Swim briefs
description: Blue swimming briefs, a little fuller at the sides than racing cuts, with dark side panels and a white drawcord.
notes: Laid flat, front up, waist at +z, 320 mm across the waist and 168 mm deep: blue body with navy waistband and side panels and a white drawcord tied at the front; fuller at the hips than the racing briefs. Slot `briefs`, batch 175's slot for swimwear worn under trousers. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Swim cap
description: A thin, skin-tight stretch cap that keeps the hair in and the water off it while swimming.
notes: Standing on its rim, 196 mm across and 124 mm tall: a hollow yellow dome with a rolled edge, on `g.hat`. CHECK VOLUME (x19): the reference gives the cap folded flat in a pocket; standing up as hats are shown it spans the air inside its dome. Slot `head`, as hats have it. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Swim fins
description: A pair of rubber fins with closed foot pockets and long stiff blades. Kicking in them drives a swimmer fast through the water; walking in them is clumsy.
notes: Lying flat as a pair, toe on +z, each 680 mm long: a black closed foot pocket on `footwear.libsonnet`'s low shoe and a yellow blade 200 mm wide at its rounded tip, with black edge rails and a channel down the middle. CHECK VOLUME (x17): the long thin blades span a box far larger than the rubber they hold. Slot `feet`, as footwear has it; fins worn over diving socks would need an over-shoe slot, which is pending. Faster swimming and slower walking need a swimming system Deadvox does not have yet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Swimming trunks
description: Loose cotton swimming shorts with an elastic waist, a drawcord and a mesh lining.
notes: Folded on a shelf, waist at +z, 304 mm by 284 mm and 56 mm tall: green cloth with a navy waistband, the white mesh lining showing at the waist edge, cream stripes down the sides, a fly seam and a white drawcord. CHECK VOLUME (x6.5): folded, the trunks fill a box much larger than the reference gives for them packed. Slot `legs`, as shorts have it. The reference gives no warmth. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wetsuit
description: A full-length suit of 3 mm neoprene lined with nylon, from neck to wrists and ankles. It traps a thin layer of water against the skin and keeps a swimmer warm in cold water.
notes: Folded on a shelf, neck at +z, 380 mm by 320 mm and 120 mm tall: black neoprene with blue side panels and collar, a grey chest zip and knee pads, the sleeves folded along the sides behind grey flatlock seams and a blue zip leash laid straight down beside the zip, on `g.jacket`. Slot `torso`, as whole-body suits take; it covers the arms and legs too, so it should block `legs`. Warmth in cold water needs a wet-and-cold system Deadvox does not have yet. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Diving socks
description: A pair of 3 mm neoprene socks with split toes and thin rubber soles, worn inside fins or on their own over rocks and reef.
notes: Lying flat side by side, both toes the same way with a gap between them, each 250 mm from heel to toe and 100 mm up the leg: black neoprene with charcoal heel and toe, a blue cuff, a black rubber sole along the underside and a dark line where the big toe splits from the rest, built locally because `g.sockPair` lays a pair heel to heel. Slot `socks`, so fins can go on over them in `feet`. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Thick diving boots
description: A pair of 5 mm neoprene boots with thick rubber soles and side zips, warm in cold water and hard-wearing on rocks and boat decks.
notes: Standing as a pair, toe on +z, each 296 mm long and 192 mm tall: black neoprene uppers and shafts, a blue collar, a black rubber sole and toe cap, a zip up the inner side and a strap round the ankle, on `footwear.libsonnet`. CHECK VOLUME (x14.6): the standing pair fills a box the reference gives for the boots squashed flat. Slot `feet`, as boots have it; open-heel fins worn over them would need an over-shoe slot, which is pending. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Diving gloves
description: A pair of flexible neoprene gloves with rubber knuckle pads, made to keep the hands warm underwater.
notes: Lying flat as a pair, backs up, fingers to +z, each 250 mm long: black neoprene with black rubber knuckle pads and blue binding round the cuffs, on `g.glovePair`. Slot `hands`, as gloves have it. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
